definitions: An international observance on November 25 to raise awareness of violence against women and girls worldwide.
examples: The UN International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women highlights the urgent need for action.
Activists organized events for the UN International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
lemma: UN International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women
synonyms: International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women
source: UN International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women
